name: bread-trail
description: Navigate and edit your Breadcrumbs graph — view hierarchies, tile explorer, quick-switch between related notes, and more.

scripts.reload: node esbuild.config.mjs production && node -e "const c=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('dev-config.json','utf8'));require('fs').copyFileSync('main.js',c.vaultPluginDir+'/main.js')" && /Applications/Obsidian.app/Contents/MacOS/obsidian-cli plugin:reload id=bread-trail
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
